verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents native multiple pipelines with distinct stage sets. Twenty does document stages on deals, kanban boards with grouping and saved custom views, and unlimited custom objects and fields. An ops user could plausibly build separate pipelines by giving each product or motion its own custom object or stage field, with its own kanban view, but that is an inferred workaround, not a documented feature. Missing for 10: explicit multi-pipeline support, per-pipeline stage configuration docs, hands-on or independent corroboration.
